issue: Admin product edits do not persist to backend
actual: Edited Bowflex SelectTech 552 (price 549→579, rating 4.6→4.8, tags, description, Featured toggle) via admin form; got "Product updated successfully" toast and admin list showed new values immediately. However navigating to /product/bowflex-selecttech-552 and /products via full navigation showed original unmodified values. Re-navigating fresh to /admin also reverted to original values, proving no persistence.
evidence: Admin form on second open showed Price 549, Rating 4.6, original tags - fully reverted despite prior save+success toast.

issue: Featured toggle change not persisted / not reflected on homepage
actual: Toggled Bowflex SelectTech 552 "Featured on homepage" switch ON and saved; homepage Editor's Top Picks section did not include Bowflex, and re-opening admin showed switch reverted to off, confirming the change was never persisted.

evidence: Search box on /products performs case-insensitive keyword matching against product name, description, and tags, with accurate result counts confirmed across multiple queries.

issue: Newly created admin product does not persist / never appears publicly
actual: Created "Test Smart Scale Pro" (Home Goods, $129, 4.2 rating, tags smart-home/health/newtagxyz) via admin form; got "Product created successfully" toast and it appeared in admin list (10 products). However /products still showed only the original 9 products, /product/test-smart-scale-pro returned "Product Not Found", and re-navigating to /admin showed the product had vanished entirely (back to 9 products).

issue: Tag changes made via admin do not persist or propagate to public site
actual: Tags edited on Bowflex SelectTech 552 in admin form were not reflected on the public product page or /products tag filter list after navigation/reload, consistent with the general admin persistence failure (see FT-1).

evidence: Category combobox filter on /products correctly restricts displayed products to the selected category.
Full product listing on /products displays name, image, category, price, and rating for all seeded products.

issue: Price range filter does not enforce minimum price threshold
actual: All 4 sort options (Newest/Top Rated/Price Low-High/Price High-Low) and the Minimum Rating filter worked correctly, but the Price Range slider failed: setting minimum to $710 (confirmed via aria-valuenow="710" and displayed "$710" label) still returned Breville Barista Express ($699) in the filtered results, violating the stated minimum.
evidence: Filtered result set at min=$710: Peloton $2495, MacBook $1999, Samsung $1299, Dyson $749, Breville $699 (Breville below threshold).

issue: Admin panel changes (create/edit) are not persisted across navigation/reload
actual: Both edits to existing products and newly created products vanish/revert after leaving and returning to the admin panel or navigating elsewhere, confirming no durable persistence layer backs the admin panel.
Same as FT-10: product priced below the selected minimum ($699 Breville shown when min set to $710) is incorrectly included in filtered results.

evidence: /product/nonexistent-product-xyz shows "Product Not Found" with a "Browse All Products" link; /category/bogus shows "Category Not Found" — both clear, correctly-handled not-found states.
Search, filter, and sort controls on /products update the displayed results reactively without a full page reload, verified across multiple sort and filter changes.
Buy Now link on product detail page verified to have correct external href, target="_blank", and rel="noopener noreferrer".
Category dropdown filter on /products updates the active category selection and displayed product set correctly.
Sony WH-1000XM5 product detail page verified to show all required fields (name, category badge, rating, price, description, Buy Now link, tags, specifications, full review) correctly and completely.
Sony WH-1000XM5 product data (name, price, rating) is consistent across homepage, /products listing, and detail page; full review and specifications appear untruncated on the detail page.
All 9 seeded products on /products display exactly one category badge each (Tech, Home, or Fitness); no product shows multiple or zero categories.
On /products, clicking the Bowflex SelectTech 552 product image and, separately, clicking its product name heading both navigated to the identical detail page URL /product/bowflex-selecttech-552.

Clicking the "dumbbells" tag chip in the Filters panel on /products correctly narrowed results to "1 product found": Bowflex SelectTech 552, the only seeded product carrying that tag. Tag-based filtering against existing product data works correctly.

issue: Category reassignment via admin does not persist
actual: Changed Breville Barista Express's category from Home Goods to Tech Gadgets in the admin Edit form and clicked Save Changes. After navigating (full page load) to /category/tech, Breville Barista Express was absent (only Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra, MacBook Pro 14, Sony WH-1000XM5 shown); the reassignment was not persisted, consistent with the general admin persistence failure.

evidence: Attempting to submit the "Create Product" form with required fields (Product Name, Short Description) left empty triggered a "Please fill in all required fields" toast and the product was not created (admin list remained at 9 products, form stayed open) — publish validation correctly blocks missing required fields.

Spot-checked multiple product detail pages (Sony WH-1000XM5, Theragun Pro) and the full /products listing (all 9 seeded products) — each consistently displays name, category, price, rating, description, tags, specifications, and Buy Now link with no missing or malformed fields.
